name: Facilities, Public Works, and Infrastructure Standing Committee
agenda_text:
FACILITIES, PUBLIC WORKS, AND INFRASTRUCTURE
  STANDING COMMITTEE SPECIAL MEETING

  FRIDAY, SEPTEMBER 11, 2026, 1 P.M.
  CITY HALL COMMUNITY ROOM - 9701 LAS TUNAS DRIVE, TEMPLE CITY

YOU HAVE THE OPPORTUNITY TO ADDRESS THE STANDING COMMITTEE AT
THE FOLLOWING TIMES:

•  AGENDA ITEM: at the time the standing committee considers the agenda item;

•  NON-AGENDA ITEM: at the time for PUBLIC COMMENTS. Please note that while
  the standing committee values your comments, pursuant to the Brown Act, the
  standing committee cannot take action on any item not listed on the agenda.

WRITTEN COMMENT

Written public comments received on the day of the meeting will be provided to the
standing committee and made part of the meeting record. Written public comments will
not be read aloud by city staff or the standing committee.

In compliance with the Americans with Disabilities Act, if you need special assistance
to participate in this meeting, please contact the City Clerk at (626) 285-2171.
Notification 48 hours prior to the meeting will enable the City to make reasonable
arrangements to ensure accessibility to this meeting.

In compliance with the Americans with Disabilities Act, if you need special assistance
to participate in this meeting, please contact the City Clerk at (626) 285-2171.
Notification 48 hours prior to the meeting will enable the City to make reasonable
arrangements to ensure accessibility to this meeting.

1. CALL TO ORDER

2. ROLL CALL - Councilmember Yu, Mayor Man

3. PUBLIC COMMENTS ON ITEMS NOT ON THE AGENDA

  The standing committee will now hear public comments regarding items not
  listed on the agenda. The procedure to address the standing committee is
  highlighted on the first page of this agenda.

September 11, 2026
Page 2 of 2

4. APPROVAL OF MINUTES

  The Standing Committee is requested to review and approve Minutes of the
  Special Standing Committee Meeting of September 4, 2026.

  Recommendation:  Approve the Special Standing Committee Meeting of
  September 4, 2026.

  Attachment:  Meeting Minutes of September 4, 2026.

5. UNFINISHED BUSINESS

  REVIEW OF PAVEMENT MANAGEMENT PROGRAM REPORT AND WORK
  PLANS

  The Standing Committee is requested to review and discuss the Pavement
  Management Program report and possible work plans.

  Presentation:  City Engineer and City Manager

  Recommendation:  Review and discuss.

6. ADJOURNMENT

CERTIFICATION OF POSTING:
I declare under penalty of perjury that I posted this notice of agenda for the meeting to be
held on September 11, 2026, on the bulletin board outside the Civic Center located at 5938
Kauffman Avenue, CA 91780, on the city hall doors, and city website as required by law, on
the date listed below.
